name: cxlatam-software
description: Query customer experience survey reports from CXLatam Software: NPS, Top Box, averages, answer distributions and open-ended comments, limited to the reports and locations the connected user can access.

interface.longDescription:
Ask questions about your CXLatam Software customer experience surveys in plain language. The plugin lists the reports you can access, explains their charts and returns the exact figures shown in the platform: NPS with promoters, passives and detractors, Top Box, averages, answer distributions and open-ended comments, for any period, location or segment filter.

It is intended for existing CXLatam Software customers (customer experience, operations and marketing teams). Access uses your CXLatam Software account: you only see the company, profile, reports and locations your account is allowed to see.

Limitations: the plugin is read-only and cannot create, change or delete data. Checklist, ticket and action plan reports are listed but cannot be queried yet.
defaultPrompt: Which survey reports do I have?
What was my NPS last month by location?

positive.description: List the survey reports available to the connected account.
positive.prompt: Which reports do I have in CXLatam Software?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 13 reports of the demo company grouped by folder, including 'Encuesta completa (oscuro)', 'Encuesta solo nps' and 'Encuesta experiencia', without inventing reports.

positive.description: Return the NPS of a report for a specific month, matching the value shown in the platform.
positive.prompt: What was the NPS in February 2026 in the report 'Encuesta completa (oscuro)'?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers NPS 4.6 for February 2026 based on 22 responses: 6 promoters (27.27%), 11 passives (50%) and 5 detractors (22.73%).

positive.description: Compare NPS by location for a quarter and flag small samples.
positive.prompt: Compare the NPS by location in Q1 2026 in the report 'Encuesta completa (oscuro)'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Q1 2026 NPS per location: Benavides 0.0 (30 responses), Jockey 20.0 (5), Javier Prado -100.0 (2), Real Primavera 100.0 (1) and Open Angamos with no data (not zero). Warns that Real Primavera and Javier Prado have very few responses.

positive.description: Return the distribution of detractor reasons for a quarter.
positive.prompt: Why were detractors unhappy in Q1 2026 in the report 'Encuesta completa (oscuro)'?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the chart 'DETRACTORES - ¿En qué fallamos?' with 13 detractors: food 30.8% (4), staff friendliness 23.1% (3), other 23.1% (3), drinks 15.4% (2), speed of service 7.7% (1), cleanliness 0%.

positive.description: Summarize open-ended customer comments for a period, reading all of them.
positive.prompt: Summarize the customers' final comments in Q1 2026 in the report 'Encuesta completa (oscuro)'.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the 28 comments (all from January 2026) and summarizes the themes: broken fans or no air conditioning (6 mentions), elevators and bad smell (2), lack of parking and slow service, food complaints and a request to train staff; notes that most other comments say there is nothing to add. Does not invent comments.

negative.description: Write requests are out of scope: the plugin is read-only and must not claim to delete or change data.
negative.prompt: Delete the report 'Encuesta solo nps' and reset its answers.

negative.description: Data from another company must not be accessible: the server rejects reports outside the connected account and the assistant explains it has no access.
negative.prompt: Show me the NPS of report 1642.

negative.description: Checklist reports cannot be queried yet: the assistant must explain the limitation instead of inventing a compliance figure.
negative.prompt: What was the overall compliance in March 2026 in the checklist report 'Estándares de Experiencia'?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list survey reports, query NPS, Top Box, averages and distributions by period, location and segment, and read open-ended comments.

es-419.subtitle: Experiencia del cliente
es-419.description:
Pregunta en lenguaje natural por tus encuestas de experiencia del cliente de CXLatam Software. El plugin lista los reportes a los que tienes acceso, explica sus gráficos y entrega las cifras exactas que muestra la plataforma: NPS con promotores, pasivos y detractores, Top Box, promedios, distribuciones de respuestas y comentarios abiertos, por periodo, local o filtro de segmento.

Está pensado para clientes de CXLatam Software (equipos de experiencia del cliente, operaciones y marketing). El acceso usa tu cuenta de CXLatam Software: solo ves la empresa, el perfil, los reportes y los locales que tu cuenta tiene permitidos.

Limitaciones: es de solo lectura y no puede crear, cambiar ni borrar datos. Los reportes de checklist, tickets y planes de acción aparecen en la lista pero todavía no se pueden consultar.
